::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 15 1900  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS West Sussex County Record Office/ Add. 16,944/7
:::

Dear [Miss Walker](people/person_2234.qmd)
Thank you for writing to tell me of the fate of the letters, I am afraid such has often befallen the like when they descend to a generation too young to care for them and not wishing for the encumbrance.  I have a screen worked in that way by my mother, but I think almost all my other possessions of the kind have worn out.

[Mr Hobart Hampden](people/person_703.qmd) has his eldest sister [Sarah](people/person_702.qmd) staying with him, and I hope she will make her home with him, as the father died in the winter and the other two sisters are in India[^1]

yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: The Rev. Alfred Bertie Hobart-Hampden (1860-1923), rector of Cottered, Herts.  His eldest sister was Sarah Maria Hobart Hampden (d.1939).  Their mother was Jane Awdry (d.1874).
